name: What common mistakes should I avoid when selecting an investment property location?

mainEntity.name: What common mistakes should I avoid when selecting an investment property location?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common mistakes include not thoroughly researching the local market, overestimating rental income, underestimating expenses, and ignoring future development plans or zoning changes. It's crucial to avoid emotional decisions and base your choice on comprehensive data. A first-party insight from Kelby Contreras is that many investors overlook the importance of local school ratings, even for properties not intended for families, as good schools often correlate with stable property values and higher rental demand in areas like Coral Gables or Pinecrest. Avoid assuming that high-traffic tourist areas automatically equate to high returns without deeper analysis.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid common mistakes like insufficient market research, overestimating income, underestimating expenses, and ignoring future development. Kelby Contreras emphasizes checking local school ratings for stable values.
